name: Are my files uploaded when splitting a PDF?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. PDFree splits PDFs entirely in your browser using JavaScript. Files never leave your device. You can verify this yourself: open your browser's DevTools → Network tab — you should not see your PDF being uploaded to a remote server during processing.

name: What page range format does PDFree accept?

acceptedAnswer.text: Enter comma-separated pages and ranges: for example 1, 3-7, 12, 15-20. Spaces are optional. You can also click individual page thumbnails to select or deselect them visually, or use quick-select buttons for odd pages, even pages, or halves of the document.

name: Can I split only specific pages from a PDF?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You can extract a custom page range (e.g. pages 3-7) or split every page into individual files. Enter the range as comma-separated values like '1-5, 8, 11-15', or click pages visually in the thumbnail grid.

name: How do I delete or remove a specific page from a PDF?

acceptedAnswer.text: Select all pages except the ones you want to remove, then click Split PDF to extract only the pages you want to keep. For example, to delete page 3 from a 10-page PDF, select pages 1-2 and 4-10 and extract them. The result is your PDF without the removed pages — original quality preserved.

name: Is there a page limit for splitting?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. PDFree has no page or file size limits. Processing depends on your device's available memory. PDFs with hundreds of pages render thumbnails in seconds on a modern computer.

name: Can I split a PDF offline?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. PDFree is a Progressive Web App and works fully offline once loaded in your browser. No internet connection is required to split or extract pages.
